name: Cluster Output Capacity
query:
SELECT
  ac.cluster_name AS `Artisan Cluster`,
  ac.region AS `Region`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.name) AS `Active Artisans`,
  AVG(pc.production_time_days) AS `Avg Production Time (Days)`,
  SUM(pc.production_time_days) AS `Total Capacity (Days)`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pc.name) AS `Unique Products`
FROM `tabArtisan Cluster` ac
LEFT JOIN `tabArtisan` a ON a.artisan_cluster = ac.name
LEFT JOIN `tabArtisan Product Catalog Entry` pc ON pc.artisan = a.name
GROUP BY ac.name
ORDER BY `Total Capacity (Days)` DESC
